in_marathi.name: Shankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of auspiciousness, peace and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shankar is a Sanskrit name which means 'The Benevolent One', 'The God of Auspiciousness', 'The God of Peace and Prosperity'. This name is derived from the Hindu god Shiva, who is the god of destruction and regeneration. Shankar is a powerful name that signifies strength, courage, wisdom and peace. It is believed that those named Shankar possess the qualities of Shiva and are blessed with his divine protection and grace.
